delivered_artifacts.artifact_class: Workflow Step Contract Architecture, Validator, Registry & Migration Engine

gate_1_complete_contract.description: Every production workflow step has a complete hash-addressed StepContract.

gate_2_agent_vs_code_typing.description: Step contracts explicitly distinguish AGENT_CALL reasoning from CODE_FUNCTION execution.

gate_3_explicit_side_effects.description: Side effects are strictly categorized as NONE, READ_ONLY, or MUTATION_OPERATION.

gate_4_explicit_failure_routing.description: Failure, timeout, and repair targets are explicitly mapped in failure_routing dictionary.

gate_5_mutation_step_rigor.description: MUTATION_OPERATION steps strictly require non-empty postconditions and validators.

gate_6_statem_boundary_anchor.description: Contracts name state_boundary, state_entry_context_requirements, blocking_exit_checks, and transition evidence.

gate_7_host_controlled_state_commit.description: Internal Agent reasoning is never mistaken for a state transition; only host runtime commits state.
